concepts.label: Product identifier
concepts.definition: A product key interpreted within its source namespace.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Match the namespace and verified key, never name similarity alone.

concepts.label: Customer account identifier
concepts.definition: A customer account key interpreted within the source system.
concepts.compatibility_rule: An organization name alone does not prove an account match.

concepts.label: Minimum purchase commitment
concepts.definition: A contract obligation to order at least a stated quantity of a specified product during a defined period.
concepts.compatibility_rule: An obligation is compared with actual ordered quantity; it is never an equivalent field.

concepts.label: Promised delivery date
concepts.definition: A date promised by a contract or amendment for delivery of a scoped order.
concepts.compatibility_rule: An operational due date may differ; shipment does not establish delivery.

concepts.label: Promised supplier lead time
concepts.definition: Contractually promised elapsed days from the stated start event to receipt for a scoped supplier/product.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Promised duration is not the source historical average. Start/end events and calendar matter.

concepts.label: Reported production scrap
concepts.definition: A source reports scrapped quantity for a product/work order.
concepts.compatibility_rule: No inference of defect rate, root cause or contractual acceptance without evidence.

concepts.label: Reported inventory quantity
concepts.definition: A source reports quantity at a product/location snapshot.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Confirm the same snapshot and location; do not equate with available-to-promise.

concepts.label: Warranty duration
concepts.definition: A promised warranty interval with a specified start event and exclusions.
concepts.compatibility_rule: No native warranty-duration field is established in this package.

concepts.label: Governing law
concepts.definition: The legal jurisdiction named by a contract clause.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Do not force a geographic-address mapping.

concepts.label: Contract effective date
concepts.definition: Date from which a specified contract version applies.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Do not equate with order date or a generic ModifiedDate.

concepts.label: Inspection and acceptance condition
concepts.definition: Conditions and evidence required for accepting supplied goods.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Scrap outcomes provide context only, not evidence of customer acceptance.

concepts.label: Supplier identifier
concepts.definition: An AdventureWorks vendor business-entity key in its declared source namespace.
concepts.compatibility_rule: Supplier and customer roles stay distinct even when labels match.
